routes.name: Independent profile verification and contraction matching

C9000352.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 352 (A finite-time singularity of Calabi flow.; papers: A finite-time singularity of Calabi flow on projective space; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_PROFILE_UNIQUE.statement: The stated square has exactly one shooting parameter whose origin solution matches the small tail constructed at s=56; the resulting positive global profile satisfies prof:profile with all differentiated asymptotics.

C_PROFILE.statement: Theorem prof:profile, including the positive global solution, its matching and differentiated all-order asymptotics, but not the compact Calabi-flow theorem.

L_ORIGIN.statement: The holomorphic origin family, its s=1 jet, tangent tail, and nonlinear parameter remainder have the asserted uniform bounds.

L_FINITE_UNIFORM.statement: Every parameter in the full square R=5e-10 continues positively through s=56 and satisfies |q|<=0.25R and ||(Re xi,Im xi)-z||_infinity<=0.13R.

L_TAIL.statement: The half-line Green operator and nonlinear contraction construct positive small tails, with the claimed residual, coordinates, decay, and continuous dependence.

L_MATCH.statement: A finite shot in the full parameter square matches a constructed small tail in all three physical jet coordinates.

L_ASYMPTOTIC.statement: The bounded matched jet equals each polynomially weighted remainder solution and has differentiated inverse-power asymptotics of every finite order.

L_SHOT_LIPSCHITZ.statement: On the full square, the finite shot has real-coordinate Lipschitz constant below 0.31 and nonreal-coordinate-minus-identity Lipschitz constant below 0.15.

L_MATCH_CONTRACTION.statement: The finite-shot-to-tail matching self-map has maximum-norm Lipschitz constant below 0.37 on the square.

L_COMPLEX_DISKS.statement: Every reference substep continues holomorphically past the closed theta-disk of radius 1/2, with bounded propagated first variations and degree-44 component tails below 48*4^(-45).

L_REFERENCE_CERTIFICATE.statement: The independently derived outward-rounded recurrences enclose all reference states and actual block variations, with the required physical midpoint widths at every block.

L_TRANSFER_PRODUCTS.statement: After correct physical scaling, all exact complete transfers, leading-block sums, weighted sums, and the required within-block first row and third column satisfy the certified bounds.

L_NONLINEAR_BOOTSTRAP.statement: Uniformly on the entire parameter square, the nonlinear perturbation is below 14R in p, the endpoint error is below 0.11R, and positivity and continuation hold through s=56.

L_PROJECTION.statement: The exact spectral projection of the uniform physical endpoint jet gives |q|<=0.25R and nonreal-coordinate error<=0.13R with all polynomial-parameter and transfer errors included.

L_TAIL_DATA.statement: The constant comparison cubic, projection and convolution bounds, four-term tail residual, and its parameter derivative satisfy the exact inequalities on the full allowed d interval.

C_CALABI_MAIN.statement: The manuscript's compact Calabi-flow finite-time singularity theorem, which is not established by profile verification alone.

C_ANCIENT_INVERSE.statement: Theorem flat:inverse with its full weighted parabolic estimates.

C_COMPACT_FLOW.statement: Theorem glue:solution: localization and nonlinear correction yield a positive compact solution with the required correction estimates.

C_GEOMETRIC_OBSTRUCTION.statement: Lemma geo:obstruction converts the corrected solution into the asserted curvature asymptotic and finite-time obstruction.
